slides.title: Ambulance peeche hai. Tum kya karoge?
slides.body: Shaam ka traffic. Bunty late hai, aur peeche se siren baj raha hai.

slides.title: Movie 7 baje ki hai.
slides.body:
Bunty scooty pe, Pinky peeche.
Peeche ambulance ka siren.
Bunty: "Sab hatenge toh main bhi hatunga."

slides.title: Bunty beech lane mein hi raha.
slides.body: Left mein jagah thi. Par "chalta hai". Ambulance ruk gayi, theek uske peeche.

slides.title: Ambulance ke andar...
slides.body: Ek buzurg patient. Paramedic baar baar ghadi dekh rahi hai. Har second bhaari.

slides.title: Pinky ne dheere se bola:
slides.body:
"Socho andar tumhare Dadaji hote."
Bunty ka dil ek second ke liye ruk gaya.

slides.title: Rasta na diya? 10,000 ka fine.
slides.body: Emergency vehicle ko rasta na dena offence hai. Fine, ya 6 mahine tak jail, ya dono.

slides.title: Green corridor yaad hai?
slides.body: Organ le jaane ke liye Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad mein poori sadak khaali hoti hai. Log khud rasta dete hain.

slides.title: Siren suna? 3 kaam.
slides.body:
Left jao.
Ruk jao.
Rasta do.
Aur ambulance ke peeche mat bhaago.

slides.title: Ab siren sunte hi, Bunty sabse pehle left.
slides.body: Aur peeche walon ko bhi ishaara: "Rasta do!"

lines: Us dost ko bhejo jo siren sunke bhi lane nahi chhodta.
